inputs.original_text: I don't buy the official line for a second on this SSANU move. The federal government has clearly been stalling the renegotiation of that 2009 agreement on purpose as part of a coordinated play by hidden elites to manufacture unrest in the universities. Now SSANU's issuing a one-month ultimatum with threats of an indefinite nationwide strike if demands aren't met, all wrapped up in their 54th National Executive Council resolutions. It's the usual elite manipulation to keep the system divided and under their control while pretending it's just about non-teaching unions.
